mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.goal_id, r.name, r.description, r.completion_criteria, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.sort_order, r.status, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stage r JOIN goal g ON g.id=r.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.id=#{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM stage r JOIN goal g ON g.id=r.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.sort_order,r.id LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM stage r JOIN goal g ON g.id=r.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage (user_id, goal_id, name, description, completion_criteria, start_date, end_date, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{completionCriteria}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE stage SET goal_id=#{goalId}, name=#{name}, description=#{description}, completion_criteria=#{completionCriteria}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, status=#{status}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(t.weight::numeric) FILTER (WHERE t.status='COMPLETED'),0)/NULLIF(SUM(t.weight::numeric),0),2) FROM stage s LEFT JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=s.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.id=#{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
